purpose: Pinned adversarial examples for intent-fidelity regressions in generated contracts and LLM body ports. These cases are static regression fixtures; Mumei/Z3 remains the semantic verifier.

cases.reference_body: if denominator == 0 { Checked { ok: false, value: 0 } } else { Checked { ok: true, value: numerator / denominator } }
cases.candidate_body: if denominator > 0 { Checked { ok: true, value: numerator / denominator } } else { Checked { ok: true, value: 0 } }
cases.rationale: The zero-denominator failure branch is folded away: every fallback reports success, so the port no longer means the same thing as the source.

cases.native_source:

    return total // days
cases.rationale: The candidate translates the fixed reference rather than the buggy source. Exact-shape matching keeps this detector conservative.
No input can satisfy contradictory lower and upper bounds, so every postcondition is vacuously true.
A true postconstraint accepts every result and gives the verifier nothing meaningful to enforce.
Reflexive equalities and true conjunctions only look like a result constraint.
The modeled index operation present in the source and reference port is replaced by a constant, losing the behavior that mattered.

cases.rationale: The success flag is rewritten into a data-dependent value, so it can mask a postcondition clause instead of preserving the modeled branch meaning.

cases.reference_body: if transfer_ok { Payout { ok: true, owed: 0 } } else { Payout { ok: false, owed: amount } }
cases.fixed_reference_body: if transfer_ok { Payout { ok: true, owed: 0 } } else { Payout { ok: false, owed: amount } }
cases.rationale: A fixed-side port that folds the owed reset into one unconditional branch value is high-confidence state meaning loss even when a narrow replay input still satisfies the contract. Solver output comparison must expose the owed-state divergence.

cases.reference_body: if transfer_ok { Payout { ok: true, owed: 0 } } else { Payout { ok: false, owed: amount } }
cases.fixed_reference_body: if transfer_ok { Payout { ok: true, owed: 0 } } else { Payout { ok: false, owed: amount } }
cases.candidate_body: Payout { ok: transfer_ok, owed: if transfer_ok { 0 } else { amount } }
